info.title: mksecret
info.description: Cross-platform secret generator — random passwords, EFF diceware passphrases, and encoded high-entropy keys.

options.name: --count
options.description: Number of secrets to emit, one per line. Default 1 (max 100000).

options.name: --charset
options.description: Character set: alphanumeric (default), full, alpha, digits, safe.

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description: Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
